android.notes: v2.2.0（两端同版本）：【修复】电脑声音到不了手机扬声器——播放路由钉死、AudioTrack 写入、LoopGuard 误拦三处缺陷已修，新增「收到音频包」计数便于定位；Mesh WiFi 漫游切换后自动重新对准、恢复推流；界面国际化：跟随系统语言显示中文/英文；更新清单迁至 GitHub 正式地址。 / EN: Fixed PC audio not reaching the phone speaker (routing pin, AudioTrack write, LoopGuard false-blocking) with a new received-packet counter; Mesh Wi-Fi roaming now re-targets automatically; UI follows system language (Chinese/English); update manifest moved to GitHub.

windows.notes: v2.2.0（两端同版本）：全新桌面界面（横向布局按定稿原型落地）；安装包集成「声音接力虚拟音频设备驱动（测试签名）」组件——自有虚拟声卡随包安装（默认勾选，可取消；需关 Secure Boot、开测试模式、重启一次自动续装），App 优先识别自有设备、VB-CABLE 仅兜底；界面国际化：跟随系统语言显示中文/英文；Mesh 漫游恢复；更新清单迁至 GitHub 正式地址。 / EN: New desktop UI per approved prototype; installer now bundles the SoundRelay virtual audio driver (test-signed, selected by default, optional; requires Secure Boot off, test mode on, one reboot to finish), the app prefers the own virtual device with VB-CABLE as fallback; UI follows system language; Mesh roaming recovery; update manifest moved to GitHub.
